text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah~! What glorious clear weather!
It's such a perfect day for an adventure, even Amaterasu would rush out barefoot!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
An adventure... umm...? 
Why was I brought along, exactly...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When I was arranging the habaneros and green onions in the kenzan...
it hit me like a bolt of lightning!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's birthdays or glossy, straight hair, it's all the same—
if it's with you, I feel like we can get our hands on the 'Hidden Treasure Available Only to Those Who Visit the Seven Mounds' ☆"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! Keep fishin' 'em up!!
The more traveling companions we have, the better!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (I-Is tuna really a friend... or just food? ...Wait, if that's the case...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(DHA, iron, protein—a sharp mind and strong body are indispensable for treasure hunting...
Could this be preparation for that?)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi-san...! There's a bear in front of the mound...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aha, so you're after Magusuke, aren't ya?!
We ain't handin' over our precious pal!!
Take thiiis! Magusuke Straiiight!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (S-She threw a tuna...?! But didn't she say they were friends...?!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...However, in the end, the bear ran off and the tuna was saved. Are you saying that swift situational judgment can bring about total victory...?)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san, you're...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "After that... crossing mountains and traversing valleys, we visited the six mounds. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The final... mound...?
But... isn't this Hanshin Racecourse...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...Countless rowdy souls sought treasure, challenged
the grand race, and fell... Their spirits rest
here to this very day."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Takara... zuka... The 'Takarazuka Kinen'...
So... that's what you meant...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (As a great senior who achieved consecutive victories in the Takarazuka Kinen, teaching juniors through fresh experiences—leading by example, that is the true treasure...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (I have received Golshi-san's guidance loud and clear. Putting to use everything I learned today... I will show everyone growth I can be proud of!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! A golden-glowing octopus squid-bake, it says!
Surely, this must be the treasure we've been seeking—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Chrono? Are you listening??
Heellllooooo?!
